test_title: PYST 5: SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 26 Oct 2023)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

**Statements:**

Some pens are books.

All book are cars.

Some cars are spoons.

**Conclusions:**

(I) : Some spoons are pens.

(II) : Some books are pens.
solution:
Given Statements:

Some pens are books.

All book are cars.

Some cars are spoons.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6289a719564427ccb6df9dee3e7cb9472e853f198933217ca1a460af20cef200.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some spoons are pens - False (Because, No definite relation given between spoons and pens, so it can be possible).

II. Some books are pens - True (Because, Some pens are books also implies that Some books are pens).

So, Only conclusion (II) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
